The TVR family

6 generations and variants in the Index, 1991–2006. Oldest first; every card opens the full page, with its own versions, figures and story.

  1. 1991–2002

    TVR Griffith

    A small fiberglass British roadster with a big Rover-based V8 and no driver aids at all, the Griffith remade TVR's reputation in the 1990s. Roughly the length of a Mazda MX-5, the 500 version offered a claimed 340 hp and asked for a careful right foot in return.

    340 hp4.1 sec 0-60169 mph top2,600 built
  2. 1992–2003

    TVR Chimaera

    The spy on holiday: dressed for dinner, packed for the Riviera and carrying a V8 it would rather not have to use. Softer and more practical than the Griffith, with a trunk for 2 golf bags, it became the TVR people kept and the company's best seller.

    285 hp4.7 sec 0-60160 mph top6,000 built
  3. 1996–2004

    TVR Cerbera

    The sleeper. A 2+2 with rear seats for 2 children and the first engine TVR designed and built itself, a flat-plane V8 that could out-accelerate cars costing far more. Family, opera, then it ruins your evening at a stoplight.

    420 hp3.9 sec 0-60195 mph top1,490 built
  4. 1999–2006

    TVR Tuscan

    The showman. Chameleon paint, a face of stacked lights and a removable roof, with the performance to back up the show. More than 850 people ordered one at its 1998 debut, and the Tuscan S went after the Porsche 911 GT3 and Ferrari 360.

    360 hp3.9 sec 0-60195 mph top1,677 built
  5. 2002–2006

    TVR Tamora

    The weekend escape artist. A 350 bhp straight-six roadster with no ABS and no traction control, barely longer than a Griffith, that made TVR performance feel natural, and was overlooked so completely that only about 356 were built.

    350 hp4.4 sec 0-60160 mph top356 built
  6. 2004–2006

    TVR Sagaris

    The assassin, here for one thing and you're it. Slashes and vents that did real work, a 406 bhp Speed Six, a built-in roll cage and only 211 made before the Blackpool factory closed. The best way a company could have gone out.

    406 hp3.7 sec 0-60185 mph top211 built
